note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse or range, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where Edwards drops words. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions in Edwards' own voice, quotations he recasts in another person, places where he argues from a KJV word OWB does not carry, and critical-text verses OWB omits.
